newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BAYERN BEATEN BY RAITH IN FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN BEATEN BY RAITH IN FRIENDLY.

text.p: Top German club Bayern Munich were beaten 1-0 by Raith Rovers, the bottom team in Scotland's premier division, in a friendly on Tuesday.
Bayern, last season's UEFA Cup champions, were without internationals Juergen Klinsmann and Christian Ziege. Lothar Matthaeus played only in the second half.
Peter Duffield scored the only goal in the 56th minute at Raith's new-look Starks' Park ground.
